title: The Observed Stop Events Schema — observed-stop-events
text: Columns: trip_ref Trip identity. GTFS-RT/baseline trip_id known, synthetic id inferred trips. Never NA. route_ref Route identity, NA unknown. shape_ref Shape identity linking trip shapes.txt, NA unknown. Set rt2s_events_from_stop_times(shape_ref_prefix=) match ids produced gps2gtfs::g2g_shapes_from_trips(); assembler writes trips.shape_id. direction_id GTFS direction (0/1), NA unknown. service_date Date. service day trip belongs (attributed trip start; post-midnight stops keep trip's date). stop_ref Stop identity; NA trip-level rows (provenance == "canceled"). stop_sequence Integer order along trip; optional (NA), assembler guarantees spec-compliant sequence. arrival_time, departure_time Absolute POSIXct times; assembler derives GTFS clock strings (>24:00:00) . provenance One "observed" (reported /passage), "predicted-last" (last prediction passage), "propagated", "skipped" (stop served), "canceled" (whole trip run). vehicle_ref Vehicle identity, NA unknown. source One "trip_updates", "positions", "gps". pattern_ref Optional, additive. K-way branch/short-turn variant identity carried gps2gtfs C5 contract; handoff cross-trip stop-order stage. Reserved nullable - NA gps2gtfs pattern detector enabled - present producer supplies , converters emit stay valid.
